# Den Ree

Musician, livecoder, A/V performer — exploring the creative potentials of code.

## Summary

Den Ree is the personal site of a musician, livecoder, and A/V performer based in Rotterdam. He performs live-coded electronic music with real-time visuals (algo-DJ sets), most notably the Machine Music project with Nikilia, developed during a residency at V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media. The site keeps a performance log of upcoming and past shows (algoraves, museum programmes, livecoding events). He also builds software for artists and creators, is the founder of NDA/studio, a creative technology studio (https://www.nda.studio), and writes a journal on livecoding, creative coding, and working with AI. Target audience: people interested in livecoding, electronic music, A/V performance, creative tech, and bookings.

## Main sections

- [Home](https://denree.nl/): Performance log (Live), Machine Music, software for artists, about, contact
- [Music](https://denree.nl/music): Machine Music project and the full performance log — upcoming and past shows
- [Journal](https://denree.nl/journal): Thoughts on livecoding music, creative coding, staying creative
- [Contact](https://denree.nl/contact): Bookings, collaborations, and general inquiry

## Music

- Machine Music: A/V performance with live-coded music and real-time visuals, in collaboration with Nikilia; developed at V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
- Performance log: upcoming and past shows at https://denree.nl/music — including EXPORT × Boijmans: Night Pioneers (Pixel Pioneers programme, Museum Boijmans Van Beuningen), Algorave Amsterdam (Vondelbunker), TOPLAP 48h Stream From Scratch, and more
- Listen: https://soundcloud.com/den-ree

## Journal

- [Finding Algoraves](https://denree.nl/journal/finding-algoraves): On discovering the algorave scene and what changes when music and visuals are performed live with code.
- [Wearing the Suit](https://denree.nl/journal/wearing-the-suit): Building with blanche vs getting blanche to build for you — wear the mechanic's suit, not the Iron Legion.

## Software for artists

- Tapelet: Multi-channel audio recording app (Beta) for capturing performances and ideas
- Content Office: Instagram planner app for creators
- NDA/studio: creative technology studio founded by Den Ree — https://www.nda.studio
